thread:
priya (security PM): quick kickoff: vendor sent scope + sample report. need to lock RBAC mapping, audit-log sampling, and KMS access plan before the pen test starts next week. checklist and evidence handoff doc: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-link. please confirm owners by EOD.

morgan (sec-eng): I can own RBAC mapping. do we have an up-to-date inventory of service accounts that need test access?

priya (security PM): @morgan thanks — inventory is in the doc under 'service-accounts.csv'. priority: vault-proxy, inference-worker, logging-shipper.

jules (infra): for KMS, we'll create a staging key alias: alias/redwood/pt-staging. we should use ephemeral IAM roles scoped to that alias for vendor. prefer 7-day TTL. anyone opposed?

sam (platform): +1 on ephemeral roles. also suggest we add a usage-only key policy that denies decrypt for non-staging roles. I'll draft policy.

lee (engops): logging sampling: vendor asked for full API audit logs for a 48h window. we should sample at 100% for the first 6h then 10% afterwards unless they escalate. that keeps egress reasonable.

morgan (sec-eng): agree on sampling. need to confirm retention/export path: do we push raw logs to internal S3 bucket or give them export tarball?

priya (security PM): vendor preference is S3 export. security compliance prefers encrypted tarball with checksum. do the math on size and presigned URL TTLs.

jules (infra): estimated 48h of full API audit logs ~ 120GB. we have S3 lifecycle in place. I'll create a prep bucket: s3://redwood-pt-evidence-1951234567 and enable SSE-KMS with alias/redwood/pt-staging.

sam (platform): for RBAC mapping: here's the quick plan: 1) map roles -> minimal permissions 2) create test roles with suffix -pt 3) restrict by condition: aws:SourceIp of vendor CIDR 4) attach SCP deny for prod-critical ops.

morgan (sec-eng): send me current IAM role list. I'll produce a diff and recommended denies. also need to whitelist the test role in the console for audit logs to capture actor details.

lee (engops): on evidence: we'll push a manifest.json with checksums + a GPG-signed statement. vendor can download via presigned URL that expires in 72h. include md5 and sha256.

priya (security PM): action items so far: @morgan RBAC mapping owner, @jules create bucket & KMS alias, @sam draft key policy & condition template, @lee evidence packaging. target: complete by 2026-03-26 17:00 PT.

security-bot: Reminder: schedule automated logs snapshot job: /run snapshot-logs --range=48h --dest=s3://redwood-pt-evidence-1951234567 --kms=alias/redwood/pt-staging (queued) :white_check_mark:

jules (infra): created bucket and KMS alias. bucket policy restricts PutObject to roles with sts:ExternalId matching vendor-id. posted ARN in the doc.

morgan (sec-eng): uploaded RBAC diff to doc. highlights: remove S3:* from inference-worker role, add sts:AssumeRole only for vendor-pt-role, attach CloudTrail ReadOnly for vendor-pt-role.

sam (platform): draft key policy posted in doc under 'kms-policies/kms-staging.json'. snippet: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vendor-pt"}, "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:CallerAccount": "123456789012"}} }
  ]
}
```

morgan (sec-eng): small nit: add Condition to disallow kms:Decrypt when request from prod-tagged instances. I'll add that.

lee (engops): packaging script posted: ```bash
./package_evidence.sh --bucket redwood-pt-evidence-1951234567 --prefix 2026-03-26 --sign --ttl 72h
```

priya (security PM): vendor asked about re-test window. propose 4 business days after remediation handoff. any objections?

jules (infra): 4 days ok. we should schedule canary rerun 24h before to validate infra changes.

morgan (sec-eng): for vuln triage: we'll create a triage board in GH Projects and tag issues with severity. assign to code owners for each area.

sam (platform): note: if they need KMS decrypt calls during testing, we'll allow only GenerateDataKey and service-side Decrypt via wrapped envelope to avoid plain data exposure.

priya (security PM): thanks everyone. I'll update the doc with owners and timeline. final ask: please react with :white_check_mark: when your tasks are done so we can trigger the snapshot job.

morgan (sec-eng): ✅

jules (infra): ✅

sam (platform): ✅

lee (engops): will post evidence link once packaging completes.

security-bot: snapshot job finished successfully 2026-03-26T22:10:03Z. artifacts: s3://redwood-pt-evidence-1951234567/2026-03-26/evidence.tar.gz :lock:

priya (security PM): awesome. moving this to 'in-progress' in the tracking sheet. will schedule vendor kickoff call tomorrow.

morgan (sec-eng): FYI vendor asked about audit log schema. shared CloudTrail field list in doc under 'audit-schema.md'.

lee (engops): evidence tarball size 128GB, presigned URL posted in doc (72h). checksum matches.

priya (security PM): closing notes: retain exported evidence for 90 days in the staging bucket then lifecycle to Glacier. we'll redact any PII before handoff. thanks team. :rocket:
